description: Get location attributes (county, flood zone, school district, etc.) for a coordinate. Queries all available datasets in one call and returns what matched. No dataset id needed — this is the simplest way to find out what's at a location. Optional radius expands the search area (meters). This is NOT a geocoder — it requires numeric coordinates, not addresses or place names.

radius.description: Expand search area by this radius in meters (max 500000). Omit for exact matches.

name: enrich_location
